scope: Read-only completed construction boundary; not whole-campaign scientific qualification.

result_operation_coverage.rationale: Open-vs-closed backbone RMSD scalar computed with center of geometry subtracted and optimal superposition. An unnamed bare expression in the source, absent from the recorded export; recovered by rerunning the unchanged original computation and exposed as requested output rmsd_open_closed.csv.
Trajectory-universe backbone atom selection supplying the mobile coordinates of the open-vs-closed RMSD endpoint written to rmsd_open_closed.csv.
Reference-universe backbone atom selection supplying the fixed open-conformation coordinates of the open-vs-closed RMSD endpoint written to rmsd_open_closed.csv.

RMSD analysis over the trajectory universe with the backbone selection and CORE/LID/NMP group selections against reference frame 0. Its result variables were overwritten by later source sections, so it is absent from the recorded export; recovered by rerunning the unchanged original computation and exposed as requested output rmsd_backbone.csv.
Execution of the backbone RMSD analysis over all trajectory frames; produces the per-frame values written to rmsd_backbone.csv.
Tabulation of the backbone analysis results as Frame, Time (ns), Backbone, CORE, LID, NMP; the serialization of the recovered rmsd_backbone.csv endpoint.
Selection of all atoms named CA into the restricted atom group used by the alpha-carbon CORE analysis; input construction for the rmsd_core_ca.csv endpoint.
RMSD analysis restricted to the CA atom group with the CORE domain selection against reference frame 0; the alpha-carbon CORE endpoint, exported in the recorded reference as rmsd_core_ca.csv.
Execution of the CA-restricted CORE RMSD analysis over all frames; produces the values in rmsd_core_ca.csv.
Tabulation of the CA-restricted CORE results as Frame, Time (ns), CORE; the serialization of the recorded rmsd_core_ca.csv endpoint.

Mass-weighted RMSD analysis over the protein alpha-carbon selection with mass weights and unweighted CORE/LID/NMP group selections against the default reference frame; exported in the recorded reference as rmsd_mass_weighted.csv.
Execution of the mass-weighted RMSD analysis over all frames; produces the values in rmsd_mass_weighted.csv.
Tabulation of the mass-weighted results as Frame, Time (ns), C-alphas, CORE, LID, NMP; the serialization of the recorded rmsd_mass_weighted.csv endpoint.

Residue-number-weighted RMSD analysis over the protein alpha-carbon selection with residue-number weights on the top-level and the CORE/LID/NMP backbone group selections; exported in the recorded reference as rmsd_residue_weighted.csv.
Execution of the residue-number-weighted RMSD analysis over all frames; produces the values in rmsd_residue_weighted.csv.
Tabulation of the residue-weighted results as Frame, Time (ns), C-alphas, CORE, LID, NMP; the serialization of the recorded rmsd_residue_weighted.csv endpoint.
